verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS that handles sensitive cap table and employee data, so whether customer data can be kept out of AI training is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions AI training, a training opt-out, or a data-use policy. Permission segmentation and credential revocation are adjacent access controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
